_about: Beam reinforcement rule rows for the LOD Upgrade pack 'Beam rebar (schedule)' (bim-ootb prompts/MODELLER_LOD_UPGRADE_PILL.md P6 SPEC; ported from bim-compiler scripts/lod/rebar_beam_defaults.json plus the three shared rows of rebar_defaults.json and the join rows the Python takes as arguments). Every row: value, unit, source. A stated schedule value always wins over a row here. No project value in this file.

beam_cover_mm.source: default: ours (cover to the stirrup surface; ACI 318-19 stated on S-001 but its cover clause was NOT read)

beam_min_clear_mm.source: default: ours (minimum clear spacing between parallel bars; the rule id R110 is the project's, the value is ours; ACI 318-19 spacing clause NOT read)

beam_layer_clear_mm.source: default: ours (clear distance between bar layers; same value as the minimum clear spacing; clause NOT read)

beam_sample_step_mm.source: default: ours (station step used to find the stretch of a bar line that lies inside the beam mesh; the end is then refined by bisection)

beam_fit_margin_mm.source: default: ours (numerical margin above the cover when a bar end or a stirrup is fitted; far below the 1 mm witness tolerance)

beam_anchorage_modelled.source: default: ours (no anchorage into supports; bars end at cover from the modelled beam end; logged)

beam_hooks_modelled.source: default: ours (stirrup hooks not modelled; logged)

beam_laps_modelled.source: default: ours (no laps; a bar over the stock length is flagged 'needs lap (not modelled)')

beam_bar_order.value: stated column order, first layer nearest the face
beam_bar_order.source: default: ours (a layer is filled in the order the schedule columns list the bars; bottom A then ADD B, top D then E)

beam_side_levels_rule.value: interior levels evenly between the outermost bar centres, spacing <= stated pitch; 'nTd' without a pitch = n/2 bars per face evenly spaced
beam_side_levels_rule.source: default: ours (reading of the stated string '2T12-300' as 2 bars per level, one per face, at most 300 mm apart over the web depth; spec R105)

beam_stirrup_rule.value: closed outer loop at the stated end-zone dia and spacing over the whole clear length, first loop at cover + d/2 from the beam end, loops that do not fit the beam mesh are skipped and counted
beam_stirrup_rule.source: default: ours (the balance-zone spacing and the inner legs are on the schedule but their zone lengths are not stated; recorded, not modelled)

beam_hanger_C_built.source: default: ours (spec section 7 lists bottom, top, side, stirrups; the earlier hand parser also leaves column C out; each stated C value is reported as NOT_BUILT)

bar_sides.source: default: ours (facets of a bar prism; the same row as the rebar pack)

inside_tol_mm.source: default: ours (INSIDE witness tolerance, from the spec: cover - 1 mm)

stock_length_mm.source: default: ours (12 m stock bar length used only for the no-lap flag)

host_class.source: default: ours (the IFC class the schedule marks are joined to)

mark_source.source: default: ours (where the type mark is read: element_name, or the name of an element_dxf2bim row; a Pset Reference can be used once the model carries it)

mark_regex.source: default: ours (group 1 = the type mark in a name like 'Beam - Concrete - Rectangular (M):GB1(300x600):<id>'; edit it for another naming)
